findings.title: A save that disables the focused control could leave keyboard focus outside an open modal
reproduction: Open client Files; select Test report.pdf; open New folder.
Fill Reviewed destination and submit while the native folder PATCH returns the original same-ID Reports receipt.
Wait for unknown-outcome copy and disabled Save, then press Tab and allow the focus to settle.
findings.result: Original unchanged settled regression passes; all10 desktop/mobile visual+keyboard cases and4 pending button/field focus controls pass. React capture remembers initial portal autoFocus; disabled-attribute observer restores only this top dialog after its previously focused control becomes disabled. Radix retains modal focus trapping.
findings.scopeNote: Dialog and vendor primitive were unchanged by earlier successor feature repairs; independently discovered current behavior is inherited, not proven introduced by CP01/CP02. No vendor edit or application edit performed by reviewer.
